facts.fact: The Office of the Executive Secretary, e-Governance published the Eswatini e-Government Interoperability Framework v1.0 (cover January 2025), with a publishing date of March 2025, setting technical policies and standards for how government systems interconnect and exchange data.

systems.owner: Office of the Executive Secretary, e-Governance, Ministry of ICT

note: The text says compliance is mandatory across MDAs and is by self-regulation; it is the framework's own statement, not an instrument naming an enforcing body, so no use fact.

claims.gtmi-daa7041e97: The World Bank's GovTech survey (2025) lists the Eswatini e-Government Interoperability Framework v1 (2025) and the framework's own text confirms it, recorded as the standing fact.
